name: Zero-Divisor Modular Encoding
description: Replaced the explicit if/else state machine with an algebraic expression modulo 25. The parameters map to factors of 2 or 5, and the assessment fails iff the product is 0 mod 25, which occurs exactly when both factors are 5. This preserves the 2-SAT logic perfectly while requiring the model to deduce the zero-divisor property rather than directly reading a boolean threshold.
